draft.title: Differentiation
card: Differentiation means a business makes its product or service different from its rivals' in a way customers want. It is one way to gain a competitive advantage.
A business can stand out through better quality, a distinctive design, better customer service or a strong brand. A brand is the name, logo and reputation that customers link to a business.
Customers need to know about the difference. Businesses can make it known through advertising and social media.
Differentiation can lead customers to choose a business even when its price is not the lowest. This can help it win sales and profit.
draft.remember: Differentiation is being different in a way customers value, and letting them know about it.

a.q: Which business is using differentiation to gain a competitive advantage?
opts: A bakery that wins customers with unique sourdough recipes
A bakery that buys flour in bulk to cut its production costs
A bakery that opens on the same street as three others
A bakery that copies the loaves sold by the bakery next door
a.why: The unique recipes make the bakery's product different in a way customers want. Buying flour in bulk is about lowering costs, which is a different way to compete, so it is not differentiation.
a.clue: Look for the business that offers something its rivals do not.

b.q: Tane runs a bike repair shop in Hobart. Rivals charge similar prices. He offers same-day repairs and posts customer reviews on social media. Why might this give him a competitive advantage?
opts: Faster service sets his shop apart, and customers can see it
His repairs cost less to produce than those of his rivals
His shop is the only one that sells bikes in Hobart
Social media posts alone make customers buy from him
b.why: Same-day repairs are a service difference customers want, and social media makes that difference known. The posts alone are not enough, because customers need a real difference to value. Nothing in the case says his costs are lower.
b.clue: Ask what makes his shop different, and how customers find out.

a.best: A bakery that wins customers with unique sourdough recipes

b.best: Faster service sets his shop apart, and customers can see it
